title: Pay $47 once for 2TB of cloud storage during this software sale
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Pay once for 2TB of cloud storage with a FileJump lifetime subscription for $47.20 (reg. $467) with code DEAL20.

Apple’s 2TB iCloud+ plan costs $9.99 a month, and that bill keeps coming for as long as your files stay there. To stop renting storage, try a FileJump 2TB cloud storage lifetime subscription. Through the 20% off apps and software sale, code DEAL20 takes the price to $47.20 (reg. $467).

That much space holds a full photo library and years’ worth of documents, with room to spare. Uploading works by dragging files straight into the FileJump dashboard in your browser, and a single file can be up to 15GB, big enough for large video projects.

You can preview images, videos, spreadsheets, Word documents, and PowerPoint files without downloading them first. For sensitive folders, enable zero-knowledge encryption so your files are encrypted on your Mac before they are uploaded. Version history tracks changes for up to a year, so an overwritten file can still come back.

Sharing works via links or email, and clients or coworkers can get free accounts to open what you send them. FileJump runs in any modern browser on your Mac, and there’s an Android app too. This deal is for new users only and can be redeemed within 30 days.

Get a FileJump 2TB lifetime subscription for $47.20 with code DEAL20.

Offer ends November 15 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
